text:
jess_customer: Hey team — seeing a 502 on generate and double billing for the same request. Request id: 8f7c9d2a. Happened ~2026-03-16T14:12:22Z. Can you look?

sam_support: sorry about that. can you paste the exact request_id and any repro curl you ran? also which org/token?

jess_customer: request_id is 8f7c9d2a, org acme-inc, token header = X-API-Key: sk_live_XXXX. I can try a curl.

mike_engineer: for us to find server traces quickly, we search Kibana with the request id field. example KQL: `request_id.keyword: "8f7c9d2a" OR trace_id: "8f7c9d2a"` set timepicker to 30m around the event. also check `edge-*` and `runtime-*` indices.

sam_support: jess — can you run this minimal curl and paste output (remove your real key if posting publicly):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hello"}' \
  -v
```
This will tell us if it's reproducible from client side.

jess_customer: running now. got a 502 and body: `\{\"error\":\"upstream reset\"\}`. attaching the small network capture.

debug-bot: debug bundle uploaded: https://internal.redwood/sdb/8f7c9d2a.zip (received).

mike_engineer: got the bundle. quick internal notes for lookup:
- Kibana KQL: `request_id.keyword: "8f7c9d2a" and @timestamp >= "2026-03-16T14:00:00"`
- Curl/gunicorn upstream logs live on `edge-prod-*` index. try this ES query snippet: `{"query":{"bool":{"must":[{"term":{"request_id.keyword":"8f7c9d2a"}}]}}}`
- If nothing in hot indices, logs might be in cold/archived (see @olivia_sre).

olivia_sre: retention FYI — hot indices retained ~30 days. we snapshot weekly to cold object storage for 180 days. retrieval from cold takes ~30-90m and needs infra task. if request timestamp >30d, ping infra with ticket and give snapshot id or request_id.

sam_support: under 30d here so should be in hot. mike can you paste the grep we use on host logs?

mike_engineer: on the host we do `zgrep -n "8f7c9d2a" /var/log/redwood/* | sed -n '1,200p'` or for structured logs: `jq -c 'select(.request_id=="8f7c9d2a")' logs.jsonl`. For edge proxy: `kubectl logs -l app=edge -c proxy --since=40m | grep 8f7c9d2a`.

jess_customer: I also see increased latency in the console before the 502. could that cause double billing?

mike_engineer: double billing usually from client retrying after timeout while server still processed the original. check request timestamps: if two requests with same request_id hit backend, that indicates client retried without idempotency key. Do you have client retry logic?

jess_customer: we do automatic retry after 10s timeout. we didn't set an idempotency key.

sam_support: ok that explains billing symptom. but still want to find root cause of upstream reset. mike — can you escalate to infra if you can't locate logs in ES?

mike_engineer: will search edge + runtime first. if not found, i'll open infra retrieval ticket referencing `8f7c9d2a` and timestamp `2026-03-16T14:12:22Z`.

olivia_sre: when opening infra ticket, include: request_id, approx timestamp, org id, and link to debug bundle. tag with `log-retrieval` and `cold-snapshot` so infra runs snapshot restore faster.

sam_support: jess — for now, please add an idempotency key to your requests to avoid duplicate charges: `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` and reduce retry aggressiveness while we investigate.

jess_customer: got it. i'll add idempotency and follow up after we patch. thanks. :thumbsup:

mike_engineer: quick note — KQL we used returned two sidecar 502s from 14:12:21-14:12:26, looks like upstream reset from nodepool-7. I've opened infra ticket #INF-4821 to retrieve full host logs from snapshot (ETA 45m). will paste results here.

sam_support: thanks everyone. marking this thread for follow-up when infra posts logs.

jess_customer: appreciate the fast help.
